description: Challenger's expedition reaches the prehistoric plateau and becomes stranded there, establishing the Treehouse while repeated attempts to understand or escape the Lost World expose its tribes, creatures and stranger phenomena.

s01e01.description: Professor Challenger assembles an expedition to prove that prehistoric life survives on an isolated Amazon plateau. The journey succeeds rather too well when the explorers become stranded among dinosaurs and meet Veronica, a woman who has grown up in the Lost World.

s01e02.description: Marguerite attempts to trade Veronica into marriage with a local chief in exchange for a route off the plateau. The bargain rapidly turns into a rescue problem and leaves the expedition's already fragile escape plans in even worse condition.

s01e03.description: A run-in with a Tyrannosaur carries the explorers into a region ruled by humanoid descendants of dinosaurs. Roxton is forced toward gladiatorial combat while the others try to undermine a society in which humans occupy the bottom of the hierarchy.

s01e04.description: A giant bee leaves Summerlee dying from venom, and the only known cure lies inside the insects' enormous hive. Veronica, Malone and Roxton must retrieve its nectar while Challenger and Marguerite keep Summerlee alive at the Treehouse.

s01e05.description: After Challenger trespasses on a burial ground, a secluded tribe demands that he remain with them. His companions can win his release only by entering a cave filled with hallucinogenic fungus and recovering the remains of an earlier explorer.

s01e06.description: Summerlee revives a drowned child and is promptly accused of witchcraft by a society mixing religious traditions into a lethal theocracy. Challenger must defend him in a trial while Veronica races to bring the others back before the sentence becomes permanent.

s01e07.description: Roxton is bitten by a stranger and develops a disease with distinctly vampiric symptoms, including a thirst for blood and an aversion to sunlight. The others search for a cure before the infection turns him from hunter into predator.

s01e08.description: A strange fog leads Roxton, Malone and Marguerite into the hands of a Druid-like order that believes Marguerite fulfills an ancient prophecy. To survive, she must pursue a sacred gemstone through a sequence of dangers that seems disturbingly tailored to her.

s01e09.description: A dying guide connected to Veronica's parents points the explorers toward a hidden refuge that may explain where they disappeared. The place appears idyllic and its inhabitants impossibly youthful, which is usually the plateau's way of announcing a catch.

s01e10.description: Malone is killed by a poisoned dart and restored by a shaman whose own sanity has collapsed. While the men try to prevent the healer's execution, Veronica and Marguerite become trapped in an old well with predators above and very little patience below.

s01e11.description: Fleeing headhunters, part of the expedition becomes trapped in an old mine inhabited by plague-stricken exiles. A waking volcano threatens the underground refuge while Veronica, Roxton and Summerlee struggle to get past the warriors blocking a rescue.

s01e12.description: Roxton intervenes when the peaceful Tinta decide to stop paying tribute to the warlike Hikari. He and Veronica teach the villagers how to defend themselves, knowing that refusing submission will bring the Hikari straight to them.

s01e13.description: Challenger discovers a crystal that grants him extraordinary powers and rapidly begins behaving less like a scientist and more like a deity. His friends must stop the experiment before unlimited ability removes what remains of his restraint.

s01e14.description: A young ruler in a kingdom modeled on Arthurian legend decides Marguerite is destined to become his queen. The explorers are drawn into court politics where prophecy, succession and a conveniently ambitious adviser make declining the honor unexpectedly dangerous.

s01e15.description: Challenger discovers that an old colleague has been conducting experiments on human and ape biology in an isolated settlement. When Veronica becomes the next intended subject, scientific curiosity gives way to a rather urgent extraction.

s01e16.description: A possible gateway home is complicated by two visitors who claim to come from the future and offer opposing versions of Marguerite's importance. One needs her dead, the other needs her returned to London carrying a catastrophe with her.

s01e17.description: Veronica encounters a man who appears to be the father she has spent years searching for. Hope gives way to suspicion as inconsistencies reveal that the reunion may be an elaborate deception aimed at exploiting her.

s01e18.description: The explorers revive Ramses, an Egyptian ruler who asks for help reclaiming a stolen throne. His version of the succession proves selectively edited, leaving the group to protect the rightful heir from the tyrant they have just helped restore.

s01e19.description: Roxton is fatally wounded while trying to save Marguerite and accepts resurrection from the mysterious Osric. Returning to life comes with a price when his benefactor demands a murder and begins demonstrating what refusal will cost.

s01e20.description: Roxton and Marguerite become guardians of a young man believed destined to free his people from oppression. Reaching the hidden Moya with the symbolic Star of Hope becomes a test of whether prophecy can survive betrayal, pursuit and the chosen one's own doubts.

s01e21.description: A fortune teller rescued by the explorers predicts a chain of events that soon appears to come true. The group tries to interpret the warnings while discovering that prophecy can be perfectly accurate and still mean something quite different from what everyone assumes.

s01e22.description: Tribune's conflict with the barbarian Drakul erupts into open war around the expedition, with gunpowder shifting the balance. The battle ends the season by scattering the group and leaving one member's fate uncertain.
